title: Blanket .cursor/ gitignore blocks tracked scout hook commits
summary: Repos with .cursor/ in gitignore need negation rules for hooks.json and hooks/** before scout hook PR can land.
retrievalQuestions: Why did git add reject .cursor/hooks.json on Scraper?
What gitignore pattern allows estate scout hooks only?

doNot: git add -f without gitignore fix — breaks repeatability
proveBeforeClaiming: git check-ignore -v .cursor/hooks.json returns no match after fix
PR includes gitignore + hooks in same change set
